diff --git a/tests/phase-6b-d110c-0c1f5b-snapshot-fixture-contract-red.test.ts b/tests/phase-6b-d110c-0c1f5b-snapshot-fixture-contract-red.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..34d07bfd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/phase-6b-d110c-0c1f5b-snapshot-fixture-contract-red.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+import "fake-indexeddb/auto";
+
+import type { InstallLiveJournalGenesisInput } from "@ts-drp/live-journal";
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+
+import { createGenuinePreparedV3Fixture } from "./fixtures/phase-3a1b-p3/live-fixture.js";
+import { createRecoveryInput } from "./fixtures/phase-4b-v3/live-snapshot.js";
+import { recoverV3LiveReplica } from "../packages/node/src/v3-live.js";
+
+describe("D.110c-0c1f5b live snapshot fixture contract", () => {
+	it("rejects unsupported epoch-anchor installation without mutating genuine epoch-zero recovery bindings", async () => {
+		const fixture = await createGenuinePreparedV3Fixture();
+		try {
+			const bindings = await createRecoveryInput(fixture, fixture.capability);
+			try {
+				const input: InstallLiveJournalGenesisInput = Object.freeze({
+					objectId: fixture.objectId,
+					exactCanonicalAnchorPreimageBytes: new Uint8Array(fixture.exactCanonicalAnchorPreimageBytes),
+					detachedAnchorSignature: new Uint8Array(fixture.detachedAnchorSignature),
+					exactCanonicalParametersCarrierBytes: new Uint8Array(fixture.exactCanonicalParametersCarrierBytes),
+				});
+				const originalInput = structuredClone(input);
+				const scope = Object.freeze({ anchorDigest: fixture.anchorDigest, epoch: 0, objectId: fixture.objectId });
+				const issuanceScope = Object.freeze({ author: fixture.author, objectId: fixture.objectId });
+				const readiness = await bindings.journal.readiness({ scope });
+				expect(readiness).toMatchObject({ ok: true, ready: true, rowCount: 0, scope });
+				if (!readiness.ok || !readiness.ready) throw new Error("genuine epoch-zero journal control is unavailable");
+				const pageInput = Object.freeze({ scope, snapshot: readiness.snapshot });
+				const journalBefore = structuredClone({ readiness, page: await bindings.journal.readPage(pageInput) });
+				expect(journalBefore.page).toMatchObject({ ok: true, rows: [], nextSequence: null, scope });
+				const issuanceBefore = structuredClone({
+					lineage: await bindings.issuanceStore.readLineage(issuanceScope),
+					issued: await bindings.issuanceStore.readIssued(issuanceScope, 0),
+					outbox: await bindings.issuanceStore.readOutboxPage({ scope: issuanceScope }),
+					plan: await bindings.issuanceStore.readSettlementPlan(issuanceScope),
+				});
+				expect(issuanceBefore.lineage).toEqual({ exhausted: false, next: 1 });
+				expect(issuanceBefore.issued).toMatchObject({ authorSequence: 0, issuedRecord: { scope: issuanceScope } });
+				expect(issuanceBefore.outbox).toEqual([{ commit: issuanceBefore.issued, publishState: "published" }]);
+				expect(issuanceBefore.plan).toBeNull();
+
+				// This fixture does not implement successor installation, even for genuine genesis-shaped input.
+				// Observe absence explicitly so RED is an outcome mismatch, never an undefined-function exception.
+				let observation: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> = { kind: "missing-required-rejection" };
+				if (typeof bindings.journal.installEpochAnchor === "function") {
+					try {
+						const pending = bindings.journal.installEpochAnchor(input);
+						observation =
+							pending instanceof Promise
+								? await pending.then(
+										(value) => ({ kind: "fulfilled", value }),
+										(error: unknown) => ({
+											kind: "asynchronous-rejection",
+											error,
+											isExactError: error instanceof Error && Object.getPrototypeOf(error) === Error.prototype,
+										})
+									)
+								: { kind: "non-promise-return", value: pending };
+					} catch (error) {
+						observation = { kind: "synchronous-throw", error };
+					}
+				}
+
+				expect(input).toEqual(originalInput);
+				expect(fixture.exactCanonicalAnchorPreimageBytes).toEqual(originalInput.exactCanonicalAnchorPreimageBytes);
+				expect(fixture.detachedAnchorSignature).toEqual(originalInput.detachedAnchorSignature);
+				expect(fixture.exactCanonicalParametersCarrierBytes).toEqual(
+					originalInput.exactCanonicalParametersCarrierBytes
+				);
+				expect({
+					readiness: await bindings.journal.readiness({ scope }),
+					page: await bindings.journal.readPage(pageInput),
+				}).toEqual(journalBefore);
+				expect({
+					lineage: await bindings.issuanceStore.readLineage(issuanceScope),
+					issued: await bindings.issuanceStore.readIssued(issuanceScope, 0),
+					outbox: await bindings.issuanceStore.readOutboxPage({ scope: issuanceScope }),
+					plan: await bindings.issuanceStore.readSettlementPlan(issuanceScope),
+				}).toEqual(issuanceBefore);
+				await expect(bindings.journal.installGenesis(input)).resolves.toEqual({
+					ok: true,
+					idempotent: false,
+					parametersDigest: fixture.descriptor.parametersDigest,
+					scope,
+				});
+				await expect(bindings.journal.installGenesis(input)).resolves.toEqual({
+					ok: true,
+					idempotent: true,
+					parametersDigest: fixture.descriptor.parametersDigest,
+					scope,
+				});
+				const recovered = await recoverV3LiveReplica(bindings.input);
+				expect(recovered).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
+
+				expect(observation, "F5B_SNAPSHOT_FIXTURE_SUCCESSOR_INSTALL_REJECTS_WITHOUT_MUTATION").toEqual({
+					kind: "asynchronous-rejection",
+					error: new Error("unexpected installEpochAnchor in live snapshot fixture"),
+					isExactError: true,
+				});
+			} finally {
+				await bindings.journal.close();
+				await bindings.issuanceStore.close();
+			}
+		} finally {
+			await fixture.close();
+		}
+	});
+});
